sourceConclusions: Layout retains explicit admin gate, blocking request boundary and auth-before-render. createPayloadRequest preserves supplied req.user when no top-level user is passed. getRootLayoutData receives the authenticated request/permissions and RootProviders owns the current SDK provider tree, ProgressBar and portal; old hand-built v3 provider assembly is retired.

All pre-existing import-map keys remain; eight new upstream dashboard widget/field keys are generated from current configuration. Blob client registration is unconditional only as an import-map dependency; storage still stays disabled without a real token.

All ten product collections explicitly retain authorship:false. Their existing draft/version and tenant/super-admin access contracts remain; llmInstructions:false avoids admitting a new writable instruction collection.

Media transformer owns the same thumbnail320x320/card960x540 variants and permitted formats, while preserving original bytes. Both public serializers read variants and continue an explicit allowlist; prefix, object keys, original metadata and tenant internals are not exposed.

Rich-text jsonSchema adapter preserves the existing open CmsRichTextDocument envelope and legacy/custom node metadata at the six intended input/output sites. Fallback documents now use independent structured clones without production type assertions.

Sizes migration delegates to the official reversible migration helper. Metadata migration only renames one existing versioned-array table/index/FK and adds fourteen nullable media metadata columns plus one index. Down locks media before checking every new metadata field; it refuses loss before DDL if v4 writes are present.

The public-v4 CLI parser is created with inert config/runtime callbacks before guarded execution; only migration/generation/help/info verbs are admitted. Upstream CRUD/jobs/run verbs, old config flags and unsupported leading options are rejected. Existing hosted target approval and dev-marker safeguards run before write commands; spawn uses an argument array and shell:false.

Semantic CSS maps all current Payload color tokens to the shared Core design-system variables, preserves forced-light MissionControl behavior, shared fonts/radii, focus tokens and reduced-motion policy. It does not introduce a parallel palette or enable product dark mode. Global shared reduced-motion rules also cover SDK portals outside wrapper subtrees.

Skill sync only adds payload/cms-migration to the existing fully-managed directory owners. Existing safe staging/swap/backup behavior is retained; new two-case regression verifies obsolete upstream files are removed from all three mirrors without leftovers.

Tests retain prior behavioral scope while adapting fixtures to the public SDK. Actual upload planner/native library tests, configuration schema checks, rich-text compatibility, generated identifier checks, versioned CLI tests and public serializer parity tests exercise the changed stable seams.

New JWT regression uses actual public SDK jwtSign/JWTAuthentication. Correctly signed unversioned/wrong-version tokens are rejected before storage; the positive current-format token reaches the same stubbed identity lookup; disableLocalStrategy blocks even a valid current token. This complements actual Supabase-cookie runtime proof without inventing a product Payload-JWT path.
